summary: Full-extraction pass over 20 stored US documents: the CFTC whistleblower annual reports FY2012-FY2025, two CFTC award orders (24-WB-02, 24-WB-03), the Deutsche Bank LIBOR press release, the California AG fraud-recoveries release and the Eleventh Circuit Zafirov opinion (stored twice under two source_ids). Adds every Customer Protection Fund table line (all tables checked against their printed closing balances), award liabilities and possible future payments from the audited notes, final-order and withdrawal counts, NCAs, non-whistleblower tips and SEC referrals, TCR supplements, chart values, confidentiality reviews, two award-order denials, three California FCA settlements, the Trafigura anti-impeding case, and a few dated events. Several reports (FY2017, FY2022-FY2024) have image-only pages read by OCR.

new_indicators.name: Other payments from the reward fund
new_indicators.definition: Money paid or incurred from a dedicated whistleblower reward fund for purposes other than awards in a period (e.g. customer education, administrative expenses of the whistleblower office); breakdown item= says which, and whether paid or incurred but unpaid.
new_indicators.notes: proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC Customer Protection Fund statutory table; needed so the fund table can be checked).

new_indicators.name: Awards accrued (determined, not yet paid)
new_indicators.definition: Whistleblower awards the programme has recorded as probable liabilities (contingent claims accrued) or preliminarily determined in a period or at a date, before payment; breakdown item= says which (e.g. item=preliminary_determinations).
new_indicators.notes: proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC fund table line 'contingent claims to Fund resources accrued'; needed so the fund table adds up).

new_indicators.name: Document requests reviewed to protect whistleblower identity
new_indicators.definition: Requests to produce or share enforcement documents that a whistleblower office reviewed in a period to protect whistleblower confidentiality; breakdown requester= (enforcement_litigation, other_agencies) and scope= (all, involving_whistleblowers, identifying_information).
new_indicators.notes: proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC annual reports from FY2017).

new_indicators.name: Share of enforcement matters involving whistleblowers
new_indicators.definition: Share of an agency's enforcement matters (investigations or actions) that involve or originate with whistleblowers, as the source states it.
new_indicators.notes: proposed by extract-whistleblowing-usa1 (CFTC FY2024 report: 'About 42% of the CFTC's enforcement matters involve whistleblowers').
